grade.summary: The submission gives a complete and correct proof of both termination and choice-independence. The lexicographically decreasing pair (N,S) is a valid well-founded measure, and the primewise gcd of valuations is correctly shown to be invariant and to reconstruct the unique terminal integer.
strengths: Correctly computes the valuation transformation as (a,b) -> (min(a,b), |a-b|).
Establishes termination using a valid lexicographic descent: N decreases when the chosen numbers are coprime, while S decreases whenever their gcd exceeds 1.
Correctly proves that at least one entry greater than 1 persists, so a terminal board has exactly one such entry.
Correctly identifies the gcd of all p-adic valuations as an invariant for each prime p.
Correctly reconstructs the terminal value M solely from the initial valuation gcds.
